title: Decisions and plans
about: Phrasal verbs for taking time over a decision and planning for the future (sleep on it, weigh sth up, think sth over, plan ahead), and for talking about plans: allowing for delays, opting or chickening out, having a lot on, being set against something.

parts.title: Other verbs connected with planning and deciding

items.pattern: sleep on it · intransitive + on: the object (nearly always it) comes after on, never sleep it on · sometimes sleep on the offer / the decision · typical: Let me sleep on it. Why don't you sleep on it?
items.meaning: wait until the next day before you decide, so you can think about it calmly
items.uk: відкласти рішення до ранку, подумати до завтра
items.example: The flat looks perfect, but the rent is high. I'd like to **sleep on it** before I sign anything.
more: Don't reply to his message while you're angry. **Sleep on it** first.
She was offered a place on the course and decided to **sleep on it** before saying yes.
items.watchOut: Це не «спати на чомусь»: sleep on it — «подумати до ранку». Майже завжди з it: Let me sleep on it. Дослівне «переспати з цим» (sleep with it) не кажуть: це має зовсім інше значення.

items.pattern: do without sth / doing sth · not separable: do without it, never do it without · can stand alone: We'll have to do without. · often after can / have to / learn to
items.meaning: manage without something you would like to have or usually have
items.example: Our car broke down last month, and we've learned to **do without** it. We cycle everywhere now.
more: There's no sugar left, I'm afraid. You'll have to **do without**.
My grandparents grew up **doing without** many things we think are normal.
items.watchOut: «Обійтися без» — do without, не make without і не pass without. Можна й без додатка: We'll have to do without. Не плутай із could do without (частина B) — «краще б без цього».

items.pattern: weigh sth up · with an object, separable: weigh up the options / weigh the options up / weigh them up, never weigh up them · objects: the pros and cons, the options, the risks, the costs · also weigh up whether / how … · weigh up A against B
items.meaning: think carefully about the good and bad sides of something before you decide
items.example: Before you buy the car, **weigh up** the cost of petrol and insurance against what you spend on buses now.
more: We **weighed up** the pros and cons of moving to the country and decided to stay in town.
She looked at both dresses for ages, **weighing them up**, and in the end bought neither.
items.watchOut: Вимова: weigh /weɪ/, як way, gh не читається. «Зважити всі за і проти» — weigh up the pros and cons. Займенник посередині: weigh them up, не weigh up them.

items.pattern: run sth by sb · informal · the idea or plan goes between run and by, the person comes after by: run the plan by Dad / run it by him · also run sth past sb · objects: an idea, a plan, a suggestion, the dates
items.meaning: tell someone about an idea or plan so that they can give their opinion before you decide
items.uk: порадитися з кимось щодо (чогось), показати комусь (ідею, план)
items.example: I like the idea of a surprise party, but let's **run it by** Dad first.
more: I'll **run** your suggestion **by** the rest of the team and let you know.
She always **runs** big decisions **by** her best friend.
items.watchOut: Після by — людина, з якою радишся: run it by my sister. Не run through (це «швидко переглянути, повторити») і не run to. Так само кажуть run sth past sb. Вираз розмовний.

items.pattern: plan ahead · intransitive: no object after ahead · plan ahead for sth (for the winter, for a trip, for retirement) · it pays to plan ahead
items.meaning: decide and arrange things now for something that will or might happen later
items.example: If you **plan ahead**, train tickets to the coast are much cheaper.
more: My sister **plans ahead** for everything: her suitcase is packed a week before every trip.
It's never too early to **plan ahead** for a big family party.
items.watchOut: «Наперед, заздалегідь» тут — ahead, не forward і не before. До чого готуєшся — через for: plan ahead for the winter.

items.pattern: think ahead · intransitive · think ahead to sth (to next year, to the future) · think several moves / years ahead
items.meaning: think about what might happen in the future and how to be ready for it
items.example: **Think ahead**: will this little flat still be big enough if you have children?
more: A good chess player always **thinks** several moves **ahead**.
I **thought ahead** and packed a raincoat, and I was the only one who stayed dry.
items.watchOut: Think ahead — думати про майбутнє загалом, без додатка. Обміркувати конкретну пропозицію — think sth over, продумати наслідки плану — think sth through. Think forward не кажуть, а think back — навпаки, згадувати минуле.

items.pattern: think sth over · with an object, separable: think over the offer / think the offer over / think it over, never think over it · objects: an offer, an idea, a suggestion · typical: I'll think it over.
items.meaning: consider an idea or offer carefully for some time before you decide
items.example: Thanks for the job offer. Can I **think it over** and give you an answer on Monday?
more: My parents **thought over** our idea of a holiday together and finally agreed.
Take the leaflet home and **think it over**. There's no hurry.
items.watchOut: «Я подумаю над цим» — I'll think it over, не I'll think over it. Займенник стоїть між think і over; іменник може бути в обох місцях: think over the offer / think the offer over.

items.pattern: think sth through · with an object, separable: think through the risks / think the plan through / think it through, never think through it · objects: a plan, the risks, the consequences, what will happen if … · often negative: hadn't thought it through
items.meaning: think carefully about all the possible results and problems of a plan before you act
items.example: Buying a dog is a big step, so **think it through**: who will walk it when you're at work?
more: They moved to the countryside without really **thinking it through**, and now they spend hours in the car.
Let's **think through** every step of the move before the big day.
items.watchOut: Think sth through — продумати все до кінця, усі ризики й наслідки; think sth over — подумати над пропозицією, перш ніж відповісти. Часто підходять обидва. Займенник посередині: think it through.

items.pattern: allow for sth · not separable: allow for it, never allow it for · objects: delays, traffic, extra costs, the weather · allow for the fact that …
items.meaning: include something in your plans, or keep it in mind when you judge a situation
items.example: The recipe says forty minutes, but **allow for** an extra ten if your oven is old.
more: Our holiday budget is £800, and that **allows for** a meal out every evening.
Grandma walks slowly, so **allow for** that when you plan the route.
items.watchOut: Allow sth — дозволити (They don't allow dogs). Allow for sth — врахувати, закласти в план (allow for delays). For не губимо й не переносимо в кінець: allow for the fact that…, не allow the fact for.

items.pattern: bargain for sth / sb doing sth · not separable · mostly negative or with more than: didn't bargain for sth / more than sb (had) bargained for · also bargain on sth
items.meaning: expect something and be ready for it (usually said about an unpleasant surprise)
items.uk: очікувати, бути готовим до (чогось); «цього я не чекав»
items.example: We expected rain in Scotland, but we didn't **bargain for** snow in June.
more: Looking after my sister's three kids for a week was more than I'd **bargained for**.
When we bought the old house, we didn't **bargain for** all the repairs it needed.
items.watchOut: Тут bargain — не «торгуватися»: not bargain for sth — «не очікувати, не бути готовим». Майже завжди із запереченням або у виразі more than I bargained for. Вимова: /ˈbɑːɡɪn/, наголос на першому складі, у кінці «-гін», а не «-гейн».

items.pattern: opt out (of sth / of doing sth) · intransitive: what you leave comes after of: opt out of the trip / of paying · opposite: opt in · a little formal; used about schemes, lists, activities
items.meaning: choose not to take part in something, or not to do something you had planned
items.uk: відмовитися (від участі), вирішити не брати участі
items.example: The gym gives you a free fitness plan, but you can **opt out** if you'd rather train alone.
more: Half the office **opted out of** the Christmas party this year.
My dad **opted out of** the family walk and stayed at home with a book.
items.watchOut: Від чого — of: opt out of the trip. Opt out — спокійний вибір; якщо відмовився, бо злякався, — chicken out. Протилежне — opt in.

items.pattern: chicken out (of sth / of doing sth) · intransitive · informal · typical: at the last minute, in the end · what you don't do comes after of: chicken out of the jump
items.meaning: decide not to do something you had planned because you are too scared
items.example: My friends all went on the giant rollercoaster, but I **chickened out** and held the bags.
more: He wanted to ask her to dance but **chickened out** at the last minute.
Don't **chicken out of** the zip wire now; you've already paid for it!
items.watchOut: Chicken out, не chicken off. Від чого — out of: chickened out of the jump. Розмовне слово: у листі до незнайомої людини краще decided not to …

items.pattern: have (got) sth on · the amount goes between have and on: have a lot on / have nothing on / have so much on, never have on a lot · questions: Have you got anything on tonight? · informal
items.meaning: have plans or arrangements, so you are busy
items.example: Can we meet next week instead? I've **got a lot on** at work at the moment.
more: **Have** you **got anything on** tonight? We could go to the cinema.
We **had** so much **on** last week that I didn't cook once.
items.watchOut: Have sth on — ще й «бути вдягненим» (She had a red coat on), тож дивись на контекст. Скільки справ — між have і on: I've got a lot on, не I have on a lot. «Купа справ» — не a lot of affairs.

items.pattern: be (completely / dead) set against sth / doing sth · against comes right after set, then a noun or -ing: set against moving, not set against to move · opposite: be set on sth · dead set against is informal
items.meaning: be strongly against an idea or plan
items.example: I'd love a dog, but my flatmate is **set against** having pets in the flat.
more: Her parents were dead **set against** her leaving school at sixteen.
I was **set against** the idea at first, but now I love it.
items.watchOut: Set against — категорично проти; set on — твердо вирішив, дуже хоче (She's set on becoming a vet). Після against — іменник або -ing: set against moving, не set against to move.

items.pattern: could do without sth / doing sth / sb doing sth · informal · almost always with could (past: could have done without) · said about something annoying or badly timed
items.meaning: said when something annoys you or makes things harder for you at that moment
items.example: I've got exams next week. I **could do without** the neighbours' builders drilling all day.
more: It's freezing, and the bus is late. I **could do without** this weather.
We **could have done without** a flat tyre on the way to the wedding.
items.watchOut: Could do without — не «міг би обійтися» в прямому сенсі, а «краще б цього не було, тільки цього бракувало». Майже завжди з could. Не плутай із could do with — «не завадило б»: I could do with a coffee.

warmup.uk: Не відповідай поки що. Подумай до ранку, а тоді скажеш.
warmup.q: Don't answer yet. ___ and tell me in the morning.
warmup.explain: Sleep on it — відкласти рішення до ранку. «Переспати з цим» дослівно не перекладають: sleep with it означає зовсім інше.

warmup.uk: Якщо доведеться, ми обійдемося без телевізора.
warmup.q: If we have to, we can ___ a TV.
warmup.explain: Обійтися без — do without. Make without і pass without так не кажуть.

warmup.uk: Перш ніж бронювати, давай порадимося з мамою.
warmup.explain: Run sth by sb — розповісти комусь про план, щоб почути його думку. Run through — швидко переглянути, повторити.

warmup.uk: Я подумаю над цим і скажу тобі завтра.
warmup.explain: Займенник стоїть між think і over: think it over.

warmup.uk: Такої довгої черги в аеропорту ми не очікували.
warmup.q: We didn't ___ such a long queue at the airport.
warmup.explain: Not bargain for sth — не очікувати, не бути готовим. Wait for — чекати на когось чи щось; count for — мати вагу, значення (Experience counts for a lot), а «розраховувати на» — count on.

warmup.uk: Вона хотіла пірнути зі скелі, але в останню мить злякалася й передумала.
warmup.q: She wanted to dive off the rock, but she ___ at the last minute.
warmup.explain: Chicken out — злякатися й відмовитися (розмовне). Частка — out, не off.

warmup.uk: Цього тижня в мене купа справ.
warmup.explain: Have a lot on — бути дуже зайнятим. A lot стоїть між have і on. Affairs — не «справи» в цьому сенсі.

warmup.q: When you plan the journey, ___ possible traffic jams.
warmup.explain: Allow for — врахувати. Allow без for — дозволити. Count with — калька з «рахуватися з».

A.q: We spent all evening ___ the pros and cons of buying a bigger car.
A.explain: Weigh up the pros and cons — зважити всі за і проти. Weigh on sb — гнітити, не давати спокою; run sth by sb — порадитися з кимось.

A.q: If you want a table at that restaurant on a Saturday, you'll need to ___.
A.explain: Планувати заздалегідь — plan ahead. Forward і before тут не вживають.

A.q: Before you agree to a three-year contract, make sure you've ___.
A.explain: Think sth through — продумати всі наслідки. Займенник посередині: thought it through. Think ahead не має додатка.

B.q: When you buy paint for the room, ___ a second coat, or you won't have enough.
B.explain: Allow for — врахувати, закласти в план. Bargain for — очікувати (зазвичай із запереченням); opt out of — відмовитися від участі.

B.q: Tom promised to give a speech at his sister's wedding, but on the day he was too nervous and ___.
B.explain: Chicken out — злякатися й відмовитися. Частка — out, не off. Set against — бути проти чогось.

B.q: My grandad is completely ___ selling his old house. He says he'll never leave it.
B.explain: Set against — категорично проти. Set on — твердо вирішив зробити, а це суперечить другому реченню; set off — вирушити в дорогу.

example.title: The flat by the sea
example.uk:
Минулої весни Анні запропонували чудову квартиру біля моря, але вона була далеко від її роботи. Анна не погодилася одразу. Вона вирішила відкласти рішення до ранку, а наступного дня порадилася із сестрою, яка сказала їй зважити всі за і проти.

Анна все добре продумала. Паркуватися там було ніде, тож їй довелося б обійтися без машини та їздити потягом, і щоранку вона закладала на дорогу додаткову годину. Мама була категорично проти переїзду, але Анна не злякалася й не відмовилася.

Чого вона не чекала, так це чайок, що кричали щоранку о п'ятій. Першого тижня, коли на роботі було стільки справ, вона б залюбки обійшлася без них!
example.en:
Last spring Anna was offered a lovely flat by the sea, but it was a long way from her job. She didn't say yes straight away. She decided to [[sleep on it|a1]], and the next day she [[ran it by|a4]] her sister, who told her to [[weigh up|a3]] the pros and cons.

Anna [[thought it through|a8]]. There was nowhere to park, so she would have to [[do without|a2]] her car and take the train, and she [[allowed for|b1]] an extra hour every morning. Her mum was completely [[set against|b6]] the move, but Anna didn't [[chicken out|b4]].

What she hadn't [[bargained for|b2]] was the seagulls screaming at five every morning. In her first week, when she [[had so much on|b5]] at work, she [[could have done without|b7]] them!
